items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: That was a record under the name of Sweets, a quintet with Eddie “Lockjaw” Davis, Oliver Jackson drums, beautiful piano player Gerry Wiggins, and Major Holley on bass.

ctx.x: That was a record under the name of Sweets, a quintet with Eddie “Lockjaw” Davis, Oliver Jackson drums, beautiful piano player Gerry Wiggins, and Major Holley on bass.
And so you were born in 1962 in the southwest of France. Can you describe the jazz scene at that time when you grew up in that region?
